message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago known for offering good vegetarian options:

| Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|----------|-----------------------|
| **Siam Square** | 1111 W. Madison St., Chicago (West Loop) | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu with dishes like Pad Thai (vegan), Massaman Curry (vegetarian), and fresh spring rolls. |
| **Baan Thai** | 1220 N. Clark St., Chicago (Near West Side) | Known for its “Vegetarian” section featuring curries, stir‑fries, and tofu pad thai. |
| **Thai House** | 2009 W. Belmont Ave., Chicago (West Town) | Provides a separate vegetarian menu; try their vegetable khao soi and tofu green curry. |
| **Mango Tree** | 400 S. Wabash Ave., Chicago (Loop) | Has a vegetarian menu with options like vegetable pad see ew, tofu satay, and vegetarian tom yum soup. |

If you’d like me to look up current reviews or make a reservation, let me know!
